acceptance: Produce one self-contained validation spec with publishable scope, acceptance criteria and complete criterion-to-selected-test mappings.
Stamp specs with the selected engine, actual model, reviewer-file digest, host, UTC time, fetched remote baseline and request/proposal digests; refuse stale remote ancestry.
Use the canonical family seal formula, reject non-finite values and detect modification of any sealed field.
Refuse secret-like text and local absolute paths in published spec content, retaining private request and proposal bodies only through digests.
Select explicit or automatic reviewer engines deterministically, reject unknown engines and preserve the prohibition on automatic fallback.
Invoke the Claude reviewer with restricted read-only tools, disabled MCP access and schema-bound output; reject error envelopes, malformed output and missing model identity.
Deliver required external authorities and supplied external evidence as exact hash-bound inputs, rejecting missing, inaccessible or changed inputs before dispatch.
Migrate existing contracts only through native revisions naming the original contract hash, preserve historical evidence and require matching approved native proposal evidence for local admission.

Admit genuine documentation-only ranges without a spec and reject executable ranges with missing, stale, malformed or tampered specs; require every changed path across the complete publication baseline-to-candidate range to fall within the selected scope, including changes preceding the spec baseline.
Make both deterministic lanes and CI execute every selected category completely while preserving fixed lane checks, historical-selection restrictions and original delivery clocks.
Preserve existing validation-contract and feature-design binding requirements.
Admit the intended maintainer instruction entrypoints and skill mirror through publication checks while continuing to reject private and look-alike paths.
Execute a configured virtualenv interpreter for Vault indexing using its configured executable path, preserving the virtualenv rather than resolving the executable to its base interpreter.

Compare proposal source observations using equivalent effective-source snapshots, retain concurrent implementation changes as unadopted observations and reject changes to bound proposal evidence or governing criteria.

Preserve controller lifecycle and reused-process rejection through process-birth checks; isolate explicit Codex launcher tests from inherited harness engine selection without changing automatic engine selection.
Preserve independent parallel-review custody, overlap and failure handling while binding the configured reviewer effort after the maximum-effort cap.
Run the complete scope-index suite through its Node entrypoint with the copied CLI dependency closure, preserving trailer provenance and execution-suffix checks.

Prepare the patch release consistently across canonical manifests, lockfile, release documentation, skill release metadata and generated client manifests while preserving product composition, transport and authentication declarations.
Exercise scoped controller admission, complete launcher fixtures and bounded reviewer settings without weakening custody assertions; classify declared governing-authority drift as an execution error.
Preserve direct-human public API version request evidence checks through proposal, receipt and commit verification.

Keep review-policy fingerprints sensitive to current module content and executable modes while reusing parsed representations only for identical content; preserve performance and lifecycle assertions.
For changes outside both deterministic lanes, run selected spec tests and native exact-candidate command coverage before CI reports success; fail immediately on spec-gate failure.
Preserve source-frontier delivery and forged-page rejection, and retain closed live-verifier arguments and deterministic release integration.

acceptance_tests.purpose: Verify sealed spec production, privacy, engine invocation, external input custody, native migration, publication-range scope, configured interpreter preservation and CI branch admission.
Preserve native contract recording, revision rules, selected execution and exact feature-design binding.
Verify both deterministic lanes retain scope admission, selected execution and their fixed verification boundaries.
Verify permitted maintainer entrypoints and continued rejection of private or misleading publication paths.
Verify equivalent proposal snapshots, concurrent source deltas and evidence or governing-criteria drift rejection.
Verify controller lifecycle, process-birth rejection and explicit launcher isolation while preserving lifecycle assertions.
Verify parallel review custody, capped effort, overlap and failure handling.
Execute the complete native scope-index suite with its copied dependencies and retained provenance checks.
Verify patch progression, consistent release markers and native release preparation.
Verify canonical and generated metadata, product composition and preserved transport and authentication declarations.
Verify scoped admission custody, governing-authority drift errors, complete launcher dependencies and bounded reviewer settings.
Verify proposal and receipt governance with complete fixtures and the required workflow-to-native-coverage chain.
Verify independent direct-human version-request evidence across proposal, receipt and commit verification.
Verify bounded discovery and review behavior, policy-sensitive evidence and isolated explicit launcher execution.
Execute native source-frontier delivery and forged-page refusal under the configured effort bound.
Verify closed verifier arguments, pre-execution refusal boundaries and the deterministic release verification command.

selection.reason: Revise the existing feature contract without dropping earlier requirements or tests. Add the affected review-series, governance, version-request, performance, source-frontier and release-integration suites and their supporting fixtures. Preserve every custody assertion, historical outcome, independent verification boundary and original 300-second delivery clock. Process kill bounds do not extend that delivery policy. Unresolved published-export provenance remains separate and cannot be reported as passing.
